visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with dark hair and black-framed glasses stands in a bright kitchen, holding two round balls of dough. In front of her is a wooden tray filled with assorted baked breads. (2) A close-up shot shows the dough balls in her hands; small cartoonish animations of Taiwanese breads appear, along with a miniature animated version of the woman dancing between the dough. (3) The woman leans on a white stand mixer in a spacious, modern kitchen. The camera cuts to the interior of the mixing bowl where a smooth dough ball is being kneaded by a metal hook. (4) A hand stretches a piece of dough to demonstrate its elasticity, showing a thin, translucent membrane under bright indoor lighting. (5) A large dough ball sits on a white table; a tiny animated woman stands next to it, gesturing excitedly. (6) The woman uses a blue-handled dough scraper to cut the large mass into several smaller portions on a clean white countertop. (7) Multiple small dough pieces are shown falling onto the surface. The woman uses both hands to roll these pieces into smooth, round balls. (8) The dough balls are arranged on a baking sheet, covered with clear plastic wrap, and placed into a drawer-style freezer by the woman. (9) The hardened, frozen dough balls are transferred into a white plastic container. The woman uses a small thermal printer to generate a yellow label and sticks it to the lid. (10) A short cut shows a brown-spotted cat sleeping peacefully on a grey bed. The scene shifts to the next morning where the woman retrieves the container from a large white refrigerator. (11) The dough is placed inside a black Yamasaki oven. A miniature animation of the woman appears on the oven door, pointing to the digital settings. (12) The woman uses a wooden rolling pin to flatten the thawed dough. Various shaped items, including sausage rolls and braided dough, are prepared on a tray. (13) A wooden brush is used to coat the dough with a glistening yellow egg wash. (14) The tray is slid into the oven. A time-lapse sequence shows the dough expanding and browning under the oven's interior light. (15) Close-up shots feature the finished products: scallion bread, egg salad rolls, and golden sausage buns. (16) The woman holds the full tray of finished Taiwanese breads, smiling and gesturing toward the camera in her bright kitchen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive baking tutorial demonstrating a 'universal frozen dough' method. It aims to teach viewers how to prep dough in bulk, store it effectively, and use it to create multiple varieties of fresh bread on demand, emphasizing convenience and quality.
